title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loader)
description: ToolSearch was used 3 times before the fix_signal workflow to load deferred MCP tool schemas (fix_signal, file tools, VCS/review tools). No moeb equivalent exists. This causes moeb-tool-origin to fail on every fix_signal invocation where tool schemas must be fetched.
proposed_resolution: Modify the moeb MCP server to eagerly register all tool schemas so ToolSearch is unnecessary, or introduce a moeb list_tools tool that returns available tool schemas.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (fix_signal overflow result)
description: The Read tool (Claude Code external) was used to retrieve the oversized fix_signal tool output from a harness-saved file at C:\Users\Simeon\.claude\projects\...\tool-results\. No moeb tool exists for reading kernel-generated overflow result files.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a paginated or chunked fix_signal result return, or add a moeb tool to retrieve kernel overflow artifacts by path, eliminating the need for external Read calls.
